name: hugo-api
description: Call any REST endpoint by its own line ("GET /api/songs") and read it into React with one cached hook — retries, ETag, request coalescing and auto-refresh after writes
author: Hugo-huy2004

scripts.test: for f in checks/*.check.mjs; do node --no-warnings "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
